methodology: Accept a personal LinkedIn profile only when the profile name and company, role, or founder-history evidence agree. Canonicalize regional LinkedIn hosts to www.linkedin.com, preserve transliteration variants, reject homonyms, and leave cases unresolved when identity evidence is insufficient.
